authoritative_for: Annals Usage owns only its versioned live interpretation of Annals-attributed model consumption and its Annals-facing live diagnostic and allowance projections.
It owns no telemetry database, token aggregate, response projection, account snapshot, credential, source delivery, job, attempt, or raw model-output record.
not_authoritative_for: Annals owns source deliveries, model-run attribution, library state, and inbox receipts; Nucleus owns job and attempt state, exact model-output records, account reads, authentication, and credentials.
Invoice truth, subscription denominators, arbitrary command identity, external rate-card publication, and non-Annals requester attribution are not Annals Usage authorities.

covers: All supported public annals-usage CLI reporting outcomes and its account, readiness, administration, and development operations in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, Annals and Nucleus interfaces, upstream and internal data surfaces, arbitrary-requester accounting, retained or offline reporting, and current runtime readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: Annals Usage is a local companion that reads product-owned public or private local interfaces described by each entry and owns only the resulting in-memory interpretation.
Its reporting output does not authorize mutation of Annals or Nucleus and cannot establish invoice, subscription, or arbitrary-command truth.
shared_privacy_and_retention: The companion reads private local Annals attribution and Nucleus output and account metadata but retains no reporting state.
It never reads, copies, or stores Nucleus credential files; per-entry effects govern any attended login delegation.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes, projectionVersion identifies reporting interpretation, and entry contract versions identify documented semantic compatibility.
No additional cross-release support, rate-card stability, migration window, or deprecation period is promised unless an entry declares it.
operational_limits: Annals Usage is bounded by the current availability and retention of its Annals and Nucleus authorities and has no offline fallback or retained projection.
Per-entry contracts define report scope, account and readiness behavior, and any narrower bounds or unsupported outcomes.
